rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for sentence-level “nevertheless” or “in contrast.”

example.english: I didn't really want to go; however, my friend invited me.
example.traditional: 我本身唔想去，不過朋友約咗我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bun2 san1 m4 soeng2 heoi3 bat1 gwo3 pang4 jau5 joek3 zo2 ngo5

rows.note: Use this no-matter-how pattern, with HOW standing for forms such as 幾 A, 幾多 N, or 點樣.

example.english: However tired we are, we still have to finish it.
example.jyutping: mou4 leon6 gei2 gui6 dou1 jiu3 zou6 jyun4

rows.note: Use this when any method is acceptable, covering both “however she could” and “do it however you like.”

example.english: You can do it however you like; you don't need to ask me.
example.traditional: 你想點做都得，唔使問我。
example.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 dim2 zou6 dou1 dak1 m4 sai2 man6 ngo5
